purpose: notice that something is wrong in production quickly and reliably, and route it to the right responder with enough context
entry_criteria: Monitoring, alerts and logs exist for the service
On-call and escalation paths are defined
procedure: Collect detection signals from alerts, synthetic checks, logs and user reports into one view.
Decide whether a signal indicates user impact; check the dashboards and recent changes.
Declare an incident when the impact threshold is met and assign severity.
Page the owner by the rota with the context: symptoms, start time, affected users, recent changes.
Record detection time and how it was detected; note if users noticed before monitoring did.
acceptance_criteria: Detection time and source are recorded
The responder received symptoms and recent changes
Cases detected by users are listed as monitoring gaps
validation_method: Incident manager review of detection performance.

validation.check: compare incident start time with first alert time
validation.expect: gap within the target, or gap recorded as an action

validation.check: confirm the page contained symptoms, time and recent changes

failure_modes.detection: First report earlier than first alert
failure_modes.response: Add or tune detection for that symptom

failure_modes.detection: Responder had to ask what was wrong
failure_modes.response: Improve the alert text and links

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: A synthetic checkout check fails twice in a row and pages the on-call engineer with the failing step and the deployment from ten minutes earlier. The incident is declared as severity 2.
